scope: Curated action API anchors; production Flow Go call sites only. This is a drift guard, not a generated API wrapper inventory.

capabilities.reason: Flow runner and compiler use Kernel's type-erased invocation path.
The core :timeout modifier delegates to Builder.Timeout.
The core modifier and retry adviser delegate to Kernel retry, with configurable Kernel backoff strategies.
The retry_all option and native retry configuration expose Kernel RetryAll as an explicit opt-in.
Callers can select Kernel's capped exponential backoff through retry configuration.
Callers can select Kernel's constant backoff through retry configuration.
The default and selectable jitter strategy use Kernel's exponential jitter backoff.
The core :concurrency modifier delegates to Kernel.
:idempotent enables Kernel's default in-memory idempotency middleware.
Runner Config can supply a Kernel idempotency store for :idempotent; FileJournal provides a persistent coordinator.
Runner Config can attach a Kernel Journal; FileJournal persists results under stable source-position and per-call step identities.
Flow parallel expressions compile to Kernel ParallelAny.
The named-parallel extension compiles to Kernel ParallelNamed.
Fallback and pool failover use Kernel FirstSuccessAny.
The race block lowers directly to Kernel RaceAny; || remains a sequential fallback operator.
The :auth modifier delegates to Kernel authorization middleware.
Flow exposes selected scalar policies but does not wire the composite Kernel Resilient policy.
Flow has no call site for Kernel per-action history recording.
Transaction execution is not wired into the Flow runner or DSL.
Flow intentionally uses compiler.DynamicResolver as its mounting boundary instead of Kernel action.Registry.
